_source: Germany, 16 Laender = the 16 game regions (DE1 to DEG). upper_secondary_school: units = schools, capacity = enrolled pupils (not places: no body publishes places), school year 2025/26, Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Statistischer Bericht 'Allgemeinbildende Schulen' (21111, file statistischer-bericht-allgemeinbildende-schulen-2110100267005.xlsx, tables 21111-01, -03, -18) and 'Berufliche Schulen und Schulen des Gesundheitswesens - Grunddaten' (21121, file statistischer-bericht-berufliche-schulen-2110200267005.xlsx, tables 21121-01, -02, -11), public and private. The set of school types is the one that is upper secondary in every Land: Gymnasien (units = all Gymnasien; capacity counts only their Sekundarbereich II pupils, because a Gymnasium also teaches lower secondary), Fachgymnasien, Fachoberschulen, Berufsoberschulen/Technische Oberschulen (Bayern reports no Fachgymnasien; it has Fach- and Berufsoberschulen instead) and Teilzeit-Berufsschulen (the school half of the dual apprenticeship, the counterpart of the French lycee professionnel); Teilzeit-Berufsschule pupils attend part of the week, so they weigh about 58% of the capacity in headcount terms, not in seat terms; capacity (Sekundarbereich II pupils of Gymnasien) and the pupils_per_teacher numerator (all their pupils) are different bases. Berufsfachschulen, Fachschulen, Fachakademien and the prevocational years are left out. Mecklenburg-Vorpommern's Gymnasium teachers are filed under 'Gymnasien (G8)' and are read from there. pupils_per_teacher: all pupils of those school types (every grade) over their teachers, headcount of full- and part-time teachers (Destatis publishes no full-time equivalents in these tables); a school type with no teacher figure in a Land (Brandenburg's Fachgymnasien and Fachoberschulen, Rheinland-Pfalz's Fachoberschulen, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern's Fachoberschulen) is left out of the level only, not out of the stock. hospital: units = hospitals (Krankenhaeuser) and capacity = set-up beds (aufgestellte Betten) per Land in 2025, Destatis table 'Krankenhaeuser 2025 nach Traegern und Bundeslaendern' (https://www.destatis.de/DE/Themen/Gesellschaft-Umwelt/Gesundheit/Krankenhauser/Tabellen/eckzahlen-krankenhaeuser.html, a live page, last updated 10 September 2026; the 16 rows were copied as read). beds_per_1000 = those beds over the Land's population on 1 January 2025, Eurostat demo_r_d2jan (sex T, age TOTAL, NUTS 1). Self-checks: the 16 Laender sum to Destatis's Deutschland rows for every school type (schools 6 485, pupils 2 236 577 with the Gymnasium Sekundarbereich II count, teachers) and to the national 1 807 hospitals and 468 803 beds. A level is the region's own value in the figure's unit; the loader normalises it.
